FOUNDER · PHI OS · REALITY NAVIGATION

Answers are becoming easier to get.
The harder question is which answer actually belongs to your reality.

Teresa Lee

Founder & Principal Architect, PHI OS

PHI OS began with a recurring question in real decisions: how can different sources help us see the same reality clearly?

Why PHI OS
Founder & Research Origin

metadata.title: Teresa Lee — Founder & Principal Architect of PHI OS
metadata.description: Teresa Lee founded PHI OS after work across financial planning, resource allocation, organizational restructuring and systems analysis revealed a recurring problem: more answers do not automatically produce a clearer reality. PHI OS develops Reality Navigation as a way to connect sources, evidence, interpretation, action and review.
